start: A member on Settings, Workouts group, default rest 2:00

user_sees: Page 'Rest timer and sounds': 'Default rest' with '2:00', 'Workout sounds', 'Rest-over sound', on Android 'Ring through Do Not Disturb', 'Show "In use" screen after each set'
must_not: A rest value that differs from the Settings row line

user_sees: Sheet 'Default rest' with 'Used for every exercise that has no rest time of its own.'; it closes and the row shows '1:30'
must_not: Exercises with their own rest time changed

user_sees: The sound plays once as a preview; the row shows its name
must_not: A different sound with the screen off than in the app

steps.action: Start a workout and tick a set
user_sees: The rest timer starts at 1:30 and the chosen sound plays at the end

start: A member on Settings, Workouts group, weekly goal Off

user_sees: A stepper showing 3 and 'Workouts a week. The Workout tab shows how many are left.'

steps.action: Go to the Workout tab and look at a placed widget
user_sees: Up next shows how many of 3 are left; the widget shows the new goal
must_not: The widget still showing the old goal

start: A member on Settings, 'More workout choices'

steps.action: Tap 'How the app picks your next weight', change 'Weight step' and 'Reps to aim for'
user_sees: Choice sheets with one plain line per choice and the default tagged 'Recommended'; rows show the new choice
must_not: Target and set hints still using the old step

steps.action: Go back, tap 'Previous numbers', pick 'Same routine'
user_sees: 'Previous, Target and notes come from the previous time you did it in this routine. Applies from your next workout.'
must_not: The open workout changed at once

steps.action: Go back, tap 'Muscle tips', turn it off
user_sees: Switch off; the 'More workout choices' line says Off
must_not: Up next still showing a muscle tip

start: A member on Settings, 'Plates and bars' (also from the plate calculator's 'Change plates')

steps.action: Pick 'Machine and cable steps' and change the plates and bar
user_sees: Rows with the plates, 'Added by you' for own plates; the bar line 'Like a 15 kg women's bar or a 10 kg EZ bar.'
must_not: Suggested weights that cannot be made with these plates

start: A member on Settings, 'Rate how hard each set felt'

steps.action: Turn 'Rate how hard each set felt' on
user_sees: Caption 'Adds a box to each set: 6 is easy, 10 is as hard as you can go'; the AI coach notes line only on a build with coach notes
must_not: An 'AI coach notes' switch on a build without it

user_sees: Each set has an effort box

start: A member whose default rest cannot be saved

steps.action: Tap 'Default rest', pick a time while the phone store fails
user_sees: 'Couldn't save it. It applies until the app closes.' in the sheet; the sheet stays open
must_not: The sheet closing as if saved

user_sees: 'Workout sounds are off: Rest is over only buzzes'
must_not: A sound playing while sounds are off

start: A member who turns settings on and back off

steps.action: Turn 'Ring through Do Not Disturb' on, then off
user_sees: Off: Rest is over follows Do Not Disturb again
must_not: Rest is over still ringing through Do Not Disturb after off
